about.hero_sub: With us, New Ideas, New Solutions, New Life!
about.about_p1: The 'Supplementary and Continuing Education' center offers educational programs in various fields. The center opens its doors to every student, undergraduate, and employee who wishes to improve their knowledge.
about.about_p2: This center, created based on modern educational requirements, is aimed at unlocking and developing the potential of each student using the world's leading teaching methods.
about.about_p3: Every year, thousands of students and undergraduates improve their knowledge and professional level at this center. Together with an experienced and knowledgeable team of teachers, our students receive all the necessary support to achieve success.
about.feature_4: Measures to improve the effectiveness of the learning process
about.feature_6: Building communication with the audience and delivering results
about.course_pedagogy_desc: Teaching work and pedagogical technology professional training courses last 18 weeks, Digital Economy professional training courses last 2 months.
about.course_japanese_desc: Japanese language courses consist of 2 levels, teaching understanding of Japanese, speaking Japanese, memorizing 500 to 1500 hieroglyphs, and correct writing skills.
about.course_computer_desc: Computer literacy courses last 9 weeks, teaching Windows 10, Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Access programs.
about.course_programming_desc: C++, Python, Data Structures and Algorithms, Web Programming – Front end, Back end, Mobile Development – Flutter are taught.
about.course_robotics_desc: The robotics program consists of 16 weeks in total, comprising 144 academic hours. Classes are held 3 days a week, with each session lasting 3 academic hours.
about.course_math_desc: Mathematics preparatory courses consist of 4 levels, each lasting 8 weeks. Algebra, geometry, and calculus are taught.
